name: MindKeeper AI
description: An AI-powered second brain to aggregate, organize, and query your scattered personal data using natural language. 500k+ organic views.
longDescription: MindKeeper AI is a personal AI assistant designed as a search engine for your life. It centralizes scattered information from YouTube, Google Drive, Notion, social bookmarks, and local files into one knowledge base, then answers natural language questions with citations. Beyond personal use, it offered an API and SDK for developers to integrate AI-driven inference. It grew to 500,000+ organic views before I pivoted into Findr AI, which evolved into Cortex and HydraDB.

name: Navigator AI
description: An open-source, self-learning browser automation agent with a self-improving memory layer. Built before the agent browser wave.
longDescription: Navigator AI is an open-source browser automation agent that learns from interactions. Custom DOM parsers reduce token usage by about 90%. A self-improving memory layer using RAG personalizes automation for recurring tasks. Built before Perplexity Comet and similar products popularized the category.

name: BannerCraft
description: Won 1st place at Google GenAI Hackathon. An AI platform for effortless, custom banner creation.
longDescription: BannerCraft makes professional promotional banners from a product image and theme using Gemini and Imagen3. Includes an editing suite and chatbot for custom images and stickers, with computer vision checks for spelling and image accuracy.

name: Microservice Blogging Platform
description: A scalable blogging platform architected with 4 microservices in Go, ensuring high availability with HAProxy.
longDescription: Four Go microservices for auth, blogs, feeds, and user management, with HAProxy load balancing, Redis caching, and Docker for horizontal scale.

name: LitmusChaos Contributions
description: Contributed to a CNCF project for chaos engineering as a Linux Foundation Mentee.
longDescription: As an LFX mentee I contributed to LitmusChaos: GraphQL to REST migration, server package refactoring to cut duplication, and test coverage above 90% across handlers and services.

name: Fine-tuning LLMs with Federated Learning
description: IEEE research on privacy-preserving LLM fine-tuning with federated learning, blockchain, and secure multi-party computation.
longDescription: Research project on federated fine-tuning of LLMs without centralizing raw data. Used FedAvg, QLoRA, and MPC concepts to fine-tune models like LLaMA 3.1 and Mistral Nemo. Benchmarked 52 models across 4 datasets. Published at IEEE Big Data.
